errors are fixed by reading errors through a structural view
(instancePath/dataPath, optional message), casting the constructor
through unknown (ajv exports the class as module.exports, which its
types do not expose under NodeNext), and dropping the Schema/Options
imports. The register-time throw now carries cause.

eslint: the shared location-tool registration moved to
registryTestSupport.ts (mirrors providerTestSupport.ts), the
orchestrator provider stub guards its tail instead of the happy path,
and the tool_result member chain is flattened. Assertions unchanged.

unchanged via toEqual, exactly once) and cites it from the spec
statement; repointed the spec's anchors by hand - the spec is absent
from origin/main so the repoint script has no baseline.

Scoped tsc over the changed files and the spec-link, spec-name,
spec-status and anchor checkers pass locally. Registry tests for this
round's facet ran green by file.
